jython:import re

# Remove underscores and spaces before or after hyphens, commas, colons, semicolons, and periods
value = re.sub(r'[_ ,]+([-.,:;])', r'\1', value)

# Remove multiple consecutive hyphens, commas, colons, semicolons, and periods
value = re.sub(r'(-|,|:|;|.){2,}', r'\g<1>', value)

# Remove leading or trailing hyphens, commas, colons, semicolons, and periods
value = re.sub(r'^[-.,:;.]|[-.,:;.]$', '', value)

# Split the cleaned string into a list of items using spaces as delimiter
items = value.split()

# Remove duplicates from the list of items
items = list(set(items))

# Join the list of items back into a single string, separated by spaces
value = ' '.join(items)

# Remove any remaining underscores and convert the first letter of each word to uppercase
value = re.sub(r'_', '', value).title()
return value
